description: Confirms that image generation follows Canvas reference rules, generation edits are full replace, metadata edits are sparse, and paid execution is handed off.
expectations: t2i rejects image / Element / resource refs; i2i requires at least one image-bearing ref
Generation edits include the complete new generation block; missing flags are cleared
Metadata edits are sparse; only flags supplied are updated
--clear-generation is mutually exclusive with all generation flags
Prompt placeholders {{type:value}} become references and round-trip via node show
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-quote-and-run; this Skill never calls --run
node: and res: refs are distinguished; internal short links are rejected
Model / ratio / resolution names are taken from the live discovery payload
